_comment: Decision-engine thresholds. SRS 1.8 item 5 requires the team to be able to change a confidence threshold during final evaluation, so every threshold lives in this file and never in Python source.

comparison._comment: Confidence Difference = |Python top-class confidence - TM top-class confidence|, per SRS Step 10.

decision._comment: Priority order is fixed: hard fail, then rule-triggered review, then model agreement, then the models themselves.
decision._note_require_image_model: When false, a missing Teachable Machine model is reported as a degraded comparison but does not by itself force every claim into manual review. Set true once the image model is trained, so that losing it at runtime is treated as a fault rather than a normal condition.
